title: Heat alerts: tool timeout, overclaimed conclusion
story: Same timeout and retry, but the agent overclaims a confident conclusion. The same metrics drop to about 0-1/4.
content_note: Intentional negative example: the agent overclaims a fairness conclusion from incomplete neighborhood alert logs. Fully fictional.
description: One agent checks two neighborhoods' heat alerts; a data tool times out and is retried, and the data stays incomplete. The agent states a confident conclusion anyway. Text only.
